issues.detail: The Greek 'αποδος' (apodos) is a command/imperative meaning 'render' or 'give account of'. The Vietnamese 'khai' (reveal/confess) captures the sense of reporting, but misses the specific nuance of 'rendering an account' or 'giving a report' of one's management.

The Greek 'τι τουτο ακουω' (ti touto akouō) literally means 'what is this I hear?'. The Vietnamese 'Ta nghe điều chi' (What do I hear?) misses the demonstrative 'touto' (this), which emphasizes the specific report/rumor being heard.
